title: Journal v2: schema-validated events, run index, and a replay digest
summary: The journal grows from a single append-only buffer file into a small subsystem. Events gain a typed envelope (actor kinds, work item, change, cost, evidence grades) validated against a JSON Schema before any byte is written; the buffer directory becomes `runs/`, with a per-work-item index under `index/` guarded by a file lock; and the reader replays a run, checking every link, while a second digest over decision fields only — the replay digest — becomes what proves a replay. Checkpoint and review writers move to the new `Actor` type and the new event shapes.

lanes.subtitle: in-process callers
lanes.summary: The engine code that produces journal events: the checkpoint runner and the review run.

lanes.label: Journal subsystem
lanes.subtitle: crates/osf/src/journal
lanes.summary: The new module tree: event model, hash chain, schema validation, run index, reader.

lanes.label: State directory
lanes.subtitle: $OSF_STATE_DIR

nodes.label: Checkpoint runner
nodes.subtitle: osf verify --checkpoint
nodes.summary: Runs moon tasks for a checkpoint and appends one verification event per task plus a checkpoint-complete event. Now builds its actor with `Actor::system("osf")` and fills the new `check_type`, `summary` and typed `grade` fields.

nodes.label: Review run
nodes.subtitle: reduce_with
nodes.summary: Writes one review-answer event per judged attempt and one review-decision event for the whole review. Its `journal.append` calls now pass `&Actor::system(ACTOR)`.

nodes.label: Journal writer
nodes.subtitle: Journal::append / append_draft
nodes.summary: Opens `<state_dir>/runs/<run>.jsonl`, refuses an unsafe run id or a run whose file already holds events, validates each draft against the event schema, records the run in the work-item index on the first accepted event, and refuses any event after run-complete.

nodes.label: Event model
nodes.subtitle: event.rs
nodes.summary: The typed envelope and its payloads: `Event`, `Actor`/`ActorKind`, `Change`, `Cost`, `EvidenceGrade`, `Severity`, `WorkItemState`, `BlockedCause`, `RunOutcome`, and ten payload variants including the new run-started, review, finding, state-change, run-complete and attention types.

nodes.label: Event schema
nodes.subtitle: event.schema.json
nodes.summary: Draft 2020-12 schema for one event envelope, with per-event-type payload branches and cross-field rules: a harness actor must name a model, a blocked state change must carry a cause, and only observed findings may name a verifier.

nodes.label: Schema validator
nodes.subtitle: schema::validate
nodes.summary: Compiles the embedded schema once into a `OnceLock<jsonschema::Validator>` and returns one reason string per problem, each naming the JSON path.

nodes.label: Hash chain
nodes.subtitle: hash.rs
nodes.summary: Computes the chain hash over prev_hash, payload, work item, change, actor and cost, and adds the replay digest: SHA-256 over each event's decision line with timings, cache, cost, run id and transcripts removed.

nodes.label: Run index
nodes.subtitle: index.rs
nodes.summary: One JSON file per work item under `<state_dir>/index`, named by the SHA-256 of the work item id, listing its run ids in recorded order. Writes go through a temp file renamed over the target while an fs4 file lock is held.

nodes.label: Journal reader
nodes.subtitle: reader::read_run
nodes.summary: Reads a run back, checking each line against the schema, the expected previous hash, the recomputed hash and the run id, and refusing any line after run-complete. Returns events, head hash, replay digest and a complete flag, or one typed error and no events.

nodes.label: runs/
nodes.subtitle: <run>.jsonl
nodes.summary: The per-run journal files, renamed from `buffer/`. Each run is its own hash chain starting from genesis.

nodes.label: index/
nodes.subtitle: <sha256(work_item)>.json
nodes.summary: Per-work-item run lists, plus a `.lock` sibling per index file. Created only when a journal carries a work item.

nodes.label: Replay reader
nodes.subtitle: RunJournal
nodes.summary: The read side of the seam: a caller replays a run and compares the replay digest, while the chain head proves the file is intact.

nodes.label: Journal tests
nodes.subtitle: crates/osf/tests
nodes.summary: Checkpoint, hook and review integration tests now read `runs/` instead of `buffer/`, and the review test asserts absent score and threshold fields rather than nulls.

nodes.label: CI evidence upload
nodes.subtitle: checkpoint-evidence
nodes.summary: The workflow's artifact path moves from `$OSF_STATE_DIR/buffer` to `$OSF_STATE_DIR/runs`.

edges.label: append(actor, payload)
edges.summary: The checkpoint runner appends verification and checkpoint-complete events through the writer, now with a system actor and the new payload fields.

edges.label: append(actor, payload)
edges.summary: The review run appends review-answer and review-decision events through the same writer.

edges.label: validate(event)
edges.summary: Every draft is serialised to JSON and checked against the schema before any byte is written; a refusal leaves the file and the chain head untouched.

edges.label: include_str!
edges.summary: The schema is embedded in the binary and compiled once per process.

edges.label: event_hash(HashInput)
edges.summary: The writer computes the chain hash over the draft's payload, work item, change, actor and cost before writing the line.

edges.label: record_run(work_item, run)
edges.summary: The first accepted event of a run records that run in its work item's index, before the journal line lands; a failed index update refuses the event.

edges.label: one JSON line per event
edges.summary: Accepted events are appended as one JSON line each to the run's journal file.

edges.label: temp file + rename
edges.summary: The index is written through a temporary sibling renamed over the target, so a reader never sees a half-written file.

edges.label: read_to_string
edges.summary: The reader loads the run's journal file and checks it line by line.

edges.label: validate(line)
edges.summary: Each line is checked against the same schema the writer used, so a schema-invalid line is reported as invalid even when its hash is correct.

edges.label: event_hash + ReplayDigest
edges.summary: The reader recomputes each event's chain hash and mixes its decision line into the replay digest, so a tampered payload breaks the chain at its own line.

edges.label: read_run(state_dir, run)
edges.summary: A replay is a read: the caller gets events, head hash, replay digest and completeness, or one typed error.

edges.label: read_dir(runs)
edges.summary: Integration tests locate journal files under `runs/` and parse one JSON value per line.

edges.label: artifact path
edges.summary: The CI job uploads the `runs/` directory as checkpoint evidence.

flows.title: Appending one validated event
flows.summary: What happens between a caller handing the journal a payload and a line landing on disk: hash, serialise, validate, index, write.

messages.label: append(actor, payload)
messages.note: The checkpoint runner builds `Actor::system("osf")` and a verification payload with the new check_type, summary and typed grade fields.

messages.label: event_hash(prev, payload, work_item, change, actor, cost)
messages.note: The chain hash covers the payload, work item, change, actor and cost; run id and timestamp are excluded.

messages.label: validate(event JSON)
messages.note: A refusal returns the reasons and writes nothing, leaving the chain head unchanged.

messages.label: record_run(work_item, run)
messages.note: Only on the first accepted event of a run, and only when the journal carries a work item.

messages.label: one JSON line
messages.note: Appended to `<state_dir>/runs/<run>.jsonl`; a run-complete event closes the run to further appends.

flows.title: Replaying a run
flows.summary: Reading a run back: every line is checked against the schema, the expected previous hash and the recomputed hash, and its decision fields are mixed into the replay digest.

messages.label: validate(line)
messages.note: A schema-invalid line is reported as invalid even when its hash recomputes correctly.

messages.label: recompute hash, mix decision line
messages.note: A tampered payload, a changed duration or cache, a deleted or swapped line all break the chain at their own line number.

messages.label: RunJournal { events, head_hash, replay_digest, complete }
messages.note: Any failure returns one typed error and no events, so a caller never sees a partial chain.
